turns.content: 4-Aminophenol contains both an aniline amino group and a phenolic hydroxyl group. Compare their nucleophilicity toward propionic anhydride under pyridine conditions.
With one equivalent of propionic anhydride, predict the major monoacylation product A and explain which heteroatom is preferentially acylated.

The second substrate is 4-propionamidophenyl propionate. Under aqueous NaOH, compare the base-hydrolysis susceptibility of its phenolic propionate ester and its amide. Do these reagents support a Hofmann rearrangement?
Predict the major product B after aqueous NaOH treatment, identifying which acyl group is removed and which remains.
Combine the two reactions and state the structures or unambiguous names of A and B, with a brief chemoselective explanation.
Check whether one equivalent of anhydride or the stated aqueous-base conditions provide any reason to change either product assignment.
Give the final identities of A and B and summarize the acylation and hydrolysis selectivity.
